comment: Read from src/Molphar.cpp at commit e511dd9, version 2.0.1. Two declared ports have no widget on the panel and so can never be clicked: input 1, which the maker left unnamed, and output 0; neither is read or written anywhere in process(). Parameter 25 is likewise unreachable: src/Molphar.cpp:411 places it at minus 10.711mm, off the left edge of the panel, it has no configParam call and nothing in process() reads it. The external clock has a real fault. src/Molphar.cpp:330 steps when the reading is 1V or more and the previous reading was below 1, but src/Molphar.cpp:334 subtracts one volt from that reading before src/Molphar.cpp:342 stores it as an integer, so a clock whose high level is between 1V and 2V always stores 0 and steps the sequence on every sample. The module's own internal gate is 10V, so the fault shows only with an external clock. The trigger output's length comes from src/Molphar.cpp:263, which adds 0.01 to a timer once per sample until it passes 1, so the trigger is about a hundred samples long and its duration in time depends on the sample rate. The maker's README says probability inputs expect 0V to +1V and that he may change this to 0V to 10V later; the installed build still clamps to 0 and 1 at src/Molphar.cpp:252. Reset is not edge-detected against a threshold: src/Molphar.cpp:229 fires on any reading above 0V.
